subject: Request: PLG onboarding credit for Nimbus Labs
messages:
From: Alyssa Tran <alyssa@nimbuslabs.ai>
To: support@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 8 Nov 2026 13:02:00 -0800
Subject: New PLG signup / credit request - Nimbus Labs

Hi Redwood team,

We just signed up a developer account for Nimbus Labs (self-serve) to evaluate inference for our docs ingestion flow. Our team hit the token limit in the playground and the signup flow suggested requesting an eval top-up. Quick details:
- Org: Nimbus Labs
- Intended use: internal R&D + prototype with 50k tokens/day for 2 weeks
- Primary contact: Alyssa Tran (Product Lead)
- Account email: alyssa@nimbuslabs.ai

I've attached a small usage snapshot and a brief summary of our evaluation plan. Could someone confirm whether we qualify for a one-time PLG onboarding credit and how long it takes to get applied? We want to continue our testing tomorrow morning.

Thanks,
Alyssa
---
Alyssa Tran
Product Lead, Nimbus Labs
alyssa@nimbuslabs.ai
(415) 555-0198

Attachment: nimbus_usage_snapshot.csv (CSV, 12KB)

From: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>
To: Alyssa Tran <alyssa@nimbuslabs.ai>
Cc: ben.carter@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 8 Nov 2026 14:10:00 -0800
Subject: Re: New PLG signup / credit request - Nimbus Labs

Hi Alyssa — welcome, and thanks for the details. I'm Michael on the PLG ops team, I handle quick credit triage for self-serve signups.

A few quick questions so we can approve the correct amount:
- Is the evaluation limited to internal users only (no customer PII)?
- Expected peak throughput (requests/sec) during the 2-week test?
- Any intent to convert to paid within 90 days?

If you can reply with quick answers I'll push this through an expedited review. Typical turnaround is within a business day, faster if we have the use-case and no compliance red flags.

Cheers,
Michael
Michael Grant
PLG Operations, Redwood Inference
michael.grant@redwood.com

Hey Michael — thanks for the quick response. Answers below:
- Internal users only, we'll scrub any customer data and stick to synthetic/examples for this eval. No PII.
- Peak expected: ~4 RPS, roughly 200k tokens/day at the start, dropping to 50k/day after initial run.
- Yes, we expect to convert to a paid plan if latency and cost look good (targeting a pilot with two dev teams within 60 days).

Let me know if you need anything else. We're in PST.

Best,
Alyssa
